post.description: Called only by the auth service. Creates the Organization and the user as its Owner in one transaction. Idempotent on the user id: a user who already owns an Organization gets it back. The request's email and name are stored on the Membership as core's copy (a missing or null name is stored as null; a replay never changes a stored copy). The contract leaves email optional only so core can deploy before auth sends it, but a Membership cannot exist without one: a request without email is refused with request.invalid before anything is written.

200.description: The Organization the user owns, newly created or created by an earlier call.

400.description: The request or the Idempotency-Key header is not valid.

401.description: The internal secret is missing or wrong.

409.description: membership.already_member: the user belongs to an Organization they do not own.

500.description: Something went wrong on our side.

post.description: Called only by the auth service with the raw token and the verified address. Creates the Membership with the offered role (never Owner) and stores the request's address, which must equal the Invitation's, and its name (null when absent) as core's copy, adds it to the Invitation's Team if it names one, and marks the Invitation accepted, in one transaction. A retry by the same user answers as the first call did. Every way the Invitation cannot be used (unknown, expired, revoked, used, a different address, an Organization that is not active) is the same invitation.invalid; an Organization status is never revealed.

post.summary: Abandon an Organization whose Owner has no account
post.description: Called only by the auth service, when the account write fails after core created the Organization and from its sweep of abandoned sign-ups. Defined by its end state: it answers status deleted whenever no live Organization with this id exists when the call returns (abandoned by this call, deleted or abandoned earlier, or never created), so success does not mean this call deleted it and a repeat, with the same key, a new key or another user, answers success. A live Organization is abandoned only if it is active (a suspended one is never abandoned: a suspension is deliberate), has exactly one member, that member is the userId and it was created less than 24 hours ago by the database clock; otherwise organization.not_abandonable and nothing changes. The check and the delete are one transaction holding the Organization lock, so a concurrent accept either lands first (then this refuses) or finds the Organization deleted. The only member is removed in the same transaction, so the user id is free when it returns; Teams, Invitations and the rest are left to the deletion job, and a pending Invitation can no longer be accepted.

200.description: No live Organization with this id exists any more.

409.description: organization.not_abandonable: a live Organization has another member, a different sole member, is a day old or more, or is suspended.

post.description: An Owner invites for Admin, Manager or Rep; an Admin only for Manager or Rep. The invitee is emailed a link that is valid for 7 days, and the token is in that email only, never in a response. An internationalised domain is converted to its ASCII form. At most 1,000 Invitations are pending at once. If the email cannot be handed to the mail system the Invitation is revoked and the answer is server.unavailable (if even that revoke fails, revoke the Invitation and invite again). Accepts an `Idempotency-Key` header. The key is stored only once the email has been handed over: a repeat before that (the first request still running, or failed) is invitation.already_pending or a new attempt, as without a key; a repeat after that returns the first Invitation and sends no second email; the same key with a different request is request.idempotency_key_reused.

schema.description: A client-chosen key, kept for 24 hours once the email has been handed over. The same key with the same request after that returns the first Invitation and sends nothing; the same key with another request is request.idempotency_key_reused (422). A repeat sent before the email is confirmed handed over is invitation.already_pending (409), not a stored answer. Without it the call is not protected against being repeated.

parameters.description: A client-chosen key, kept for 24 hours once the email has been handed over.
